name: Gaussian Process Occupancy Model
definition: Models the scene as a distribution of surfaces where the geometric classification function Φ(x) is a random variable. The occupancy α(x) is the probability that a point x is on or inside an object.
summary: The Gaussian Process Occupancy Model defines voxel occupancy as a probability derived from a Gaussian Process, offering a probabilistic interpretation that enables robust optimization through orientation assignment based on the expected gradient of the mean function.
